verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents a dedicated Sandbox API environment separate from production. It provides test cards and account details for simulating transactions there, simulated test payments to fund wallets, test 3DS2 flows, and an SDK preproduction configuration flag. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience, explicit documentation of sandbox/production credential separation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
